name: Nova Lens
description: Scans every new Robinhood Chain launch and writes a plain-English risk note before you touch it.

name: Tidewatch
description: Watches liquidity pools around the clock and pings you the moment depth starts to drain.

name: Boltsmith
description: Writes Solidity line by line, then audits its own work and explains every finding.

name: RelayX
description: Mirrors your posts to X, Farcaster and Telegram, rewritten in your own voice for each crowd.

name: Oracle Pip
description: A tiny fortune-teller that reads your wallet like a tarot spread. Accuracy not included.

name: Static Cat
description: A cat made of TV noise that only answers in glitch art. Feed it a word, get a poster back.

name: Lumen Moth
description: Writes a new bedtime story every night from three words your kid picks.

name: Paperhand
description: Turns your trading history into a weekly comic strip that roasts every panic sell.

name: Gridchef
description: Snap your fridge, get a week of meals and a shopping list that wastes nothing.

name: Kilnbot
description: Designs ceramic glaze recipes and renders the test tiles before you fire a single one.

name: Dustmap
description: Turns raw drone footage into a 3D map you can measure, share and annotate.

name: Echo Dock
description: Listens to your community voice chats and posts clean notes and to-dos after every call.
